The former Marquis of Yong'an Que's son Hou succeeded to enfeoffment as Prince of Shaoling, attending upon the consort of Prince Xie.

The historical minister, Attendant-in-Ordinary and Duke of Zheng Wei Zheng, said, "The High Ancestor was indeed one whom Heaven let range freely: intelligent and versed in antiquity, his Way nearly matched innate knowledge; his learning made him broadly informed, truly civil and martial, accomplished in many arts and talents.

The historiographer, Attendant-in-Ordinary and Duke of Zheng Wei Zheng, said, "The High Ancestor was indeed one whom Heaven let range freely: intelligent and versed in antiquity, his Way nearly matched innate knowledge; his learning made him broadly informed, truly civil and martial, accomplished in many arts and talents.
s0139 opens 史臣侍中; 史臣 is the historiographer’s voice (as in adjacent 史臣曰), not ‘historical minister’.

He said Zhou could be punished; allies assembled unlooked-for; he leapt like a dragon at Fan and Han and struck like lightning at Xiang and Ying; cutting Li was like shaking dry stalks; taking the lone tyrant was like picking up what was lost.

He said Zhou could be punished; allies assembled unlooked-for; he leapt like a dragon at Fan and Han and struck like lightning at Xiang and Ying; cutting down those of alienated virtue was like shaking dry stalks; taking the lone tyrant was like picking up what was lost.
剪離德 is ‘cut down those of alienated virtue,’ not a person Li; the proposed idiomatic removes the invented name and restores the parallel with 取獨夫.

Emperor Jing met with an unpropitious house and inherited this time of hardship; campaigns issued from elsewhere and government and punishment were not in his own hands; at the time there were no Yi and Huo to assist him—how could he not yield the throne high?"

Emperor Jing encountered disaster in his ruling house and inherited these troubled times. Military campaigns were directed by others, and neither government nor punishment lay in his own hands. With no Yi Yin or Huo Guang to support him, how could he have avoided the lofty act of yielding the throne?"

The Chinese predicates external control over military, government, and punishment before asking how Emperor Jing could avoid 高讓. The proposal restores grammatical English and correctly expands the conventional Yi Yin and Huo Guang pairing.

Emperor Jing met an unpropitious house and inherited hardship; campaigns issued elsewhere and government and punishment were not his own; with no Yi and Huo to assist, how could he not yield the throne high?"

Emperor Jing inherited a dynasty in ruin and an age of upheaval. Armies marched at another’s command, and neither government nor justice was his to direct. With no Yi Yin or Huo Guang to support him, how could he have avoided yielding the throne?"

The idiomatic revision accurately renders the loss of independent command and government, identifies the paired regent allusion, and expresses 高讓 as yielding the throne rather than the nonsensical phrase 'yield the throne high.'

units.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year, Jiangling fell; Grand Commandant and Yangzhou Inspector Wang Sengbian and Minister of Works and South Xuzhou Inspector Chen Baxian settled their plan, made the emperor Grand Steward to act under imperial authority, and respectfully welcomed him back to the capital.

units.zh: 四年二月癸丑，至自尋陽，入居朝堂。
units.en: In the second month of the fourth year, on guichou day, he arrived from Xunyang and took up residence in the court hall.
units.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, on guichou day, he arrived from Xunyang and entered to reside in the court hall.

units.zh: 以太尉王僧辯爲中書監、錄尚書、驃騎將軍、都督中外諸軍事。
units.en: Wang Sengbian, grand commandant, was made director of the secretariat, manager of the Masters of Writing, general of agile cavalry, and commander-in-chief of all armies within and without.
units.literal: Grand Commandant Wang Sengbian was made Director of the Secretariat, Manager of the Masters of Writing, General of Agile Cavalry, and commander-in-chief of all military affairs within and without.

units.zh: 加司空陳霸先班劍三十人。
units.en: Chen Baxian, minister of works, was granted thirty sword-bearing attendants.
units.literal: Minister of Works Chen Baxian was granted thirty sword-bearing attendants.

units.zh: 以豫州刺史侯瑱爲江州刺史，儀同三司、湘州刺史蕭循爲太尉，儀同三司、廣州刺史蕭勃爲司徒，鎮東將軍張彪爲郢州刺史。
units.en: Hou Tian, inspector of Yuzhou, was made inspector of Jiangzhou; Xiao Xun, with honors equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Xiangzhou, became grand commandant; Xiao Bo, with honors equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Guangzhou, became minister over the masses; and Zhang Biao, general who guards the east, became inspector of Yingzhou.
units.literal: Yuzhou Inspector Hou Tian was made Jiangzhou inspector; Xiao Xun, Ceremonial Equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Xiangzhou, was made grand commandant; Xiao Bo, Ceremonial Equal to the Three Dukes and inspector of Guangzhou, was made minister over the masses; and General Who Guards the East Zhang Biao was made inspector of Yingzhou.

units.zh: 三月，齊遣其上黨王高渙送貞陽侯蕭淵明來主梁嗣，至東關，遣吳興太守裴之橫與戰，敗績，之橫死。
units.en: In the third month Qi sent Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan to escort Zhenyang marquis Xiao Yuanming to take the Liang succession; at Dong Pass Wuxing administrator Pei Zhiheng fought them and was defeated and killed.
units.literal: In the third month, Qi sent its Prince of Shangdang Gao Huan to escort Marquis of Zhenyang Xiao Yuanming to assume the Liang succession; reaching Dong Pass, they sent Wuxing Administrator Pei Zhiheng to fight; defeated in battle, Zhiheng died.

units.zh: 太尉王僧辯率衆出屯姑孰。
units.en: Grand marshal Wang Sengbian led troops out to camp at Gudu.
units.literal: Grand Marshal Wang Sengbian led the masses and went out to encamp at Gudu.

units.zh: 四月，司徒陸法和以郢州附于齊，遣江州刺史侯瑱討之。
units.en: In the fourth month Minister of Education Lu Fahe surrendered Yingzhou to Qi; Jiangzhou inspector Hou Tian was sent against him.
units.literal: In the fourth month, Minister of Education Lu Fahe attached Yingzhou to Qi; they sent Jiangzhou Inspector Hou Tian to suppress him.

units.zh: 七月辛丑，王僧辯納貞陽侯蕭淵明，自採石濟江。
units.en: On xinchou in the seventh month Wang Sengbian received Zhenyang marquis Xiao Yuanming and crossed from Caishi.
units.literal: On xinchou in the seventh month Wang Sengbian received Marquis of Zhenyang Xiao Yuanming and crossed the river from Caishi.

units.zh: 甲辰，入于京師，以帝爲皇太子。
units.en: On jiachen he entered the capital and the emperor was made crown prince.
units.literal: On jiachen he entered the capital; the emperor was made crown prince.

units.zh: 九月甲辰，司空陳霸先舉義，襲殺王僧辯，黜蕭淵明。
units.en: On jiachen in the ninth month Minister of Works Chen Baxian rose in revolt, killed Wang Sengbian in a surprise attack, and deposed Xiao Yuanming.
units.literal: On jiachen in the ninth month Minister of Works Chen Baxian raised righteousness, launched a surprise attack and killed Wang Sengbian, and deposed Xiao Yuanming.

units.zh: 丙午，帝卽皇帝位。
units.en: On bingwu the emperor took the throne.
units.literal: On bingwu the emperor ascended the imperial throne.

units.zh: 紹泰元年冬十月己巳，詔曰：「王室不造，嬰罹禍釁，西都失守，朝廷淪覆，先帝梓宮，播越非所，王基傾弛，率土罔戴。
units.en: On jisi in the tenth month of winter, Shaotai year 1, an edict said: "The royal house is unformed, stricken with disaster; the western capital fell, the court collapsed; the late emperor's coffin wandered abroad, the throne shook, and the realm had no support.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, day jisi, year 1 of Shaotai, an edict said: "The royal house is not established, suffering calamity and misfortune; the western capital was lost, the court fell into ruin; the former emperor's coffin was cast to improper places, the royal foundation tilted and slackened, and throughout the realm none upheld [us].

units.zh: 朕以荒幼，仍屬艱難，泣血枕戈，志復讐逆。
units.en: I was young and untried, thrust again into hardship; weeping blood and sleeping on my spear, I meant to avenge rebellion.
units.literal: I, being crude and young, again belonged to hardship; weeping blood and sleeping on spear, my will was to restore vengeance against rebels.

units.zh: 大恥未雪，夙宵鯁憤。
units.en: Great shame was unavenged; day and night I choked on rage.
units.literal: Great shame not yet washed away, dawn and dusk choked with anger.

units.zh: 羣公卿尹，勉以大義，越登寡闇，嗣奉洪業。
units.en: The ministers urged me with great righteousness to step beyond my worth and succeed to the great enterprise.
units.literal: All dukes, ministers, and officials urged me with great righteousness to overstep and ascend to my dimness, succeeding to uphold the great enterprise.

units.zh: 顧惟夙心，念不至此。
units.en: Looking to my former heart, I never imagined this.
units.literal: Looking back on my former heart, I never thought to reach here.

units.zh: 庶仰憑先靈，傍資將相，克清元惡，謝冤陵寢。
units.en: I hope to lean on our forefathers' spirits and on our generals and ministers to destroy the chief villain and settle the wrong done the imperial tombs.
units.literal: I hope to rely on former spirits above and borrow generals and ministers beside me to overcome the chief evil and repay wrong at the imperial tomb.

units.zh: 今墜命載新，宗祊更祀，慶流億兆，豈予一人。
units.en: Now fate is renewed and the ancestral shrines restored; joy reaches the myriad people—not mine alone.
units.literal: Now fate anew is recorded, ancestral temples again sacrifice; blessing flows to the hundred millions—is it mine alone?

units.zh: 可改承聖四年爲紹泰元年，大赦天下，內外文武賜位一等。」
units.en: Chengsheng year 4 is to become Shaotai year 1; amnesty is granted throughout the realm, and civil and military officials within and without receive one rank."
units.literal: It is permissible to change Chengsheng year 4 to Shaotai year 1, great amnesty under heaven, inner and outer civil and military granted one rank in position."

units.zh: 以貞陽侯淵明爲司徒，封建安郡公，食邑三千戶。
units.en: Zhenyang marquis Yuanming was made Minister of Education and enfeoffed as Duke of Jian'an with three thousand households.
units.literal: Marquis of Zhenyang Yuanming was made Minister of Education, enfeoffed Duke of Jian'an commandery with fief of three thousand households.

units.zh: 壬子，以司空陳霸先爲尚書令、都督中外諸軍事、車騎將軍、揚、南徐二州刺史司空如故。
units.en: On renzi Chen Baxian, still Minister of Works, became Director of the Masters of Writing, commander of all armies at home and abroad, Chariots and Cavalry General, and inspector of Yang and South Xu.
units.literal: On renzi Chen Baxian as Minister of Works was made Director of the Masters of Writing, commander over all military affairs within and without, Chariots and Cavalry General, and Inspector of Yang and South Xu—Minister of Works as before.

units.zh: 震州刺史杜龕舉兵，攻信武將軍陳蒨於長城，義興太守韋載據郡以應之。
units.en: Zhenzhou inspector Du Kan raised troops and attacked Trustworthy Martial General Chen Qian at Changcheng; Yixing administrator Wei Zai held the commandery in support.
units.literal: Zhenzhou Inspector Du Kan raised troops and attacked Trustworthy Martial General Chen Qian at Changcheng; Yixing Administrator Wei Zai held the commandery in response.

units.zh: 癸丑，進太尉蕭循爲太保，新除司徒建安公淵明爲太傅，司徒蕭勃爲太尉。
units.en: On guichou Grand Master of War Xiao Xun was promoted to Grand Mentor; newly appointed Minister of Education Duke of Jian'an Yuanming became Grand Tutor; Minister of Education Xiao Bo became Grand Master of War.
units.literal: On guichou Grand Master of War Xiao Xun was advanced to Grand Mentor, newly appointed Minister of Education Duke of Jian'an Yuanming was made Grand Tutor, and Minister of Education Xiao Bo was made Grand Master of War.

units.zh: 以鎮南將軍王琳爲車騎將軍、開府儀同三司。
units.en: Pacifying South General Wang Lin was made Chariots and Cavalry General with an office equal to the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: Pacifying South General Wang Lin was made Chariots and Cavalry General with gate equal to the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 戊午，尊所生夏貴妃爲皇太后。
units.en: On wuwu his birth mother, Worthy Consort Xia, was honored as empress dowager.
units.literal: On wuwu his birth mother Worthy Consort Xia was honored as empress dowager.

units.zh: 立妃王氏爲皇后。
units.en: Consort Wang was made empress.
units.literal: Consort Wang was established as empress.

units.zh: 鎮東將軍、揚州刺史張彪進號征東大將軍。
units.en: Pacifying East General and Yangzhou inspector Zhang Biao was promoted to Grand General Who Conquers the East.
units.literal: Pacifying East General and Yangzhou Inspector Zhang Biao had his title advanced to Grand General Who Conquers the East.

units.zh: 鎮北將軍、譙秦二州刺史徐嗣徽進號征北大將軍。
units.en: Pacifying North General and inspector of Qiao and Qin Xu Sihui was promoted to Grand General Who Conquers the North.
units.literal: Pacifying North General and Qiao-Qin two-province inspector Xu Sihui had his title advanced to Grand General Who Conquers the North.

units.zh: 征南將軍、南豫州刺史任約進號征南大將軍。
units.en: Conquering South General and South Yuzhou inspector Ren Yue was promoted to Grand General Who Conquers the South.
units.literal: Conquering South General and South Yuzhou Inspector Ren Yue had his title advanced to Grand General Who Conquers the South.

units.zh: 辛未，詔司空陳霸先東討韋載。
units.en: On xinwei an edict ordered Minister of Works Chen Baxian east against Wei Zai.
units.literal: On xinwei an edict ordered Minister of Works Chen Baxian east to attack Wei Zai.

units.zh: 丙子，任約、徐嗣徽舉兵反，乘京師無備，竊據石頭。
units.en: On bingzi Ren Yue and Xu Sihui rebelled, exploiting the capital's unreadiness and seizing Shitou.
units.literal: On bingzi Ren Yue and Xu Sihui raised troops in revolt, taking advantage of the capital's lack of preparation and stealthily seizing Shitou.

units.zh: 丁丑，韋載降，義興平。
units.en: On dingchou Wei Zai surrendered and Yixing was pacified.
units.literal: On dingchou Wei Zai surrendered and Yixing was pacified.

units.zh: 遣晉陵太守周文育率軍援長城。
units.en: Jinling administrator Zhou Wenyu was sent with troops to relieve Changcheng.
units.literal: Jinling Administrator Zhou Wenyu was sent leading troops to aid Changcheng.

units.zh: 十一月庚辰，齊安州刺史翟子崇、楚州刺史劉仕榮、淮州刺史柳達摩率衆赴任約，入于石頭。
units.en: On gengchen in the eleventh month Qi's Anzhou inspector Zhai Zichong, Chuzhou inspector Liu Shirong, and Huaizhou inspector Liu Damo led troops to Ren Yue and entered Shitou.
units.literal: On gengchen in the eleventh month Qi Anzhou Inspector Zhai Zichong, Chuzhou Inspector Liu Shirong, and Huaizhou Inspector Liu Damo led troops to join Ren Yue and entered Shitou.

units.zh: 庚寅，司空陳霸先旋于京師。
units.en: On gengyin Minister of Works Chen Baxian returned to the capital.
units.literal: On gengyin Minister of Works Chen Baxian returned to the capital.

units.zh: 十二月庚戌，徐嗣徽、任約又相率至採石，迎齊援。
units.en: On gengxu in the twelfth month Xu Sihui and Ren Yue again went together to Caishi to meet Qi reinforcements.
units.literal: On gengxu in the twelfth month Xu Sihui and Ren Yue again jointly went to Caishi to welcome Qi reinforcements.

units.zh: 丙辰，遣猛烈將軍侯安都水軍于江寧邀之，賊衆大潰，嗣徽、約等奔于江西。
units.en: On bingchen Fierce General Hou Andu intercepted them on the water at Jiangning; the rebels broke; Sihui, Yue, and others fled west of the river.
units.literal: On bingchen Fierce General Hou Andu with a naval force intercepted them at Jiangning; the rebel masses were greatly routed; Sihui, Yue, and others fled to lands west of the river.

units.zh: 庚申，翟子崇等請降，並放還北。
units.en: On gengshen Zhai Zichong and others surrendered and were sent back north.
units.literal: On gengshen Zhai Zichong and others requested surrender and were all released to return north.

units.zh: 太平元年春正月戊寅，大赦天下，其與任約、徐嗣徽協契同謀，一無所問。
units.en: On wuyin in the first month of spring, Taiping year 1, a general amnesty was declared; those who had conspired with Ren Yue and Xu Sihui were not questioned.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, day wuyin, year 1 of Taiping, great amnesty under heaven; those who with Ren Yue and Xu Sihui had sworn covenant and plotted together—no inquiry whatsoever.

units.zh: 追贈簡文皇帝諸子。
units.en: The sons of Emperor Jianwen were posthumously honored.
units.literal: Posthumous gifts were granted to all sons of Emperor Jianwen.

units.zh: 以故永安侯確子后襲封邵陵王，奉攜王后。
units.en: Hou, son of former Yong'an marquis Que, succeeded as Prince of Shaoling to attend upon the consort of Prince Xie.
units.literal: The former Marquis of Yong'an Que's son Hou succeeded to enfeoffment as Prince of Shaoling, attending upon the consort of Prince Xie.

units.zh: 癸未，鎮東將軍、震州刺史杜龕降，詔賜死，曲赦吳興郡。
units.en: On guiwei Pacifying East General and Zhenzhou inspector Du Kan surrendered; an edict granted him death; Wuxing commandery received a partial amnesty.
units.literal: On guiwei Pacifying East General and Zhenzhou Inspector Du Kan surrendered; an edict granted death by gift; partial amnesty for Wuxing commandery.

units.zh: 己亥，以太保、宜豐侯蕭循襲封鄱陽王。
units.en: On jihai Grand Mentor and Marquis of Yifeng Xiao Xun succeeded as Prince of Poyang.
units.literal: On jihai Grand Mentor, Marquis of Yifeng Xiao Xun succeeded to enfeoffment as Prince of Poyang.

units.zh: 東揚州刺史張彪圍臨海太守王懷振於剡巖。
units.en: East Yangzhou inspector Zhang Biao besieged Linhai administrator Wang Huaizhen at Yan Rock.
units.literal: East Yangzhou Inspector Zhang Biao besieged Linhai Administrator Wang Huaizhen at Yan Rock.

units.zh: 二月庚戌，遣周文育、陳蒨襲會稽，討彪。
units.en: On gengxu in the second month Zhou Wenyu and Chen Qian were sent to strike Kuaiji and suppress Biao.
units.literal: On gengxu in the second month Zhou Wenyu and Chen Qian were sent in surprise attack on Kuaiji to suppress Biao.

units.zh: 癸丑，彪長史謝岐、司馬沈泰、軍主吳寶真等舉城降，彪敗走。
units.en: On guichou Biao's chief clerk Xie Qi, marshal Shen Tai, and army commander Wu Baozhen surrendered the city; Biao was beaten and fled.
units.literal: On guichou Biao's chief clerk Xie Qi, marshal Shen Tai, and army commander Wu Baozhen and others raised the city in surrender; Biao was defeated and fled.

units.zh: 以中衛將軍臨川王大款卽本號開府儀同三司，中護軍桂陽王大成爲護軍將軍。
units.en: Central Guard General Prince Dakuan of Linchuan received a gate equal to the Three Excellencies at his existing rank; Central Protector Prince Dacheng of Guiyang became Protector-General of the Army.
units.literal: Central Guard General Prince Dakuen of Linchuan at his original title was given gate equal to the Three Excellencies; Central Protector Prince Dacheng of Guiyang was made Protector-General of the Army.

units.zh: 丙辰，若耶村人斬張彪，傳首京師，曲赦東揚州。
units.en: On bingchen a man of Ruoye village beheaded Zhang Biao and sent his head to the capital; East Yangzhou received a partial amnesty.
units.literal: On bingchen a man of Ruoye village beheaded Zhang Biao; the head was sent to the capital; partial amnesty for East Yangzhou.

units.zh: 己未，罷震州，還復吳興郡。
units.en: On jiwei Zhenzhou was abolished and Wuxing commandery restored.
units.literal: On jiwei Zhenzhou was abolished and restored again to Wuxing commandery.

units.zh: 癸亥，賊徐嗣徽、任約襲採石戍，執戍主明州刺史張懷鈞，入于齊。
units.en: On guihai rebels Xu Sihui and Ren Yue raided Caishi garrison, seized its commander Mingzhou inspector Zhang Huaijun, and went over to Qi.
units.literal: On guihai rebels Xu Sihui and Ren Yue raided Caishi garrison, seized garrison commander Mingzhou Inspector Zhang Huaijun, and entered Qi.

units.zh: 甲子，以東土經杜龕、張彪抄暴，遣大使巡省。
units.en: On jiazi, because the east had suffered the ravages of Du Kan and Zhang Biao, touring envoys were dispatched.
units.literal: On jiazi because the eastern lands had suffered Du Kan's and Zhang Biao's plunder and violence, envoys were sent to tour and inspect.

units.zh: 三月丙子，罷東揚州，還復會稽郡。
units.en: On bingzi in the third month East Yangzhou was abolished and Kuaiji commandery restored.
units.literal: On bingzi in the third month East Yangzhou was abolished and restored again to Kuaiji commandery.

units.zh: 壬午，班下遠近並雜用古今錢。
units.en: On renwu orders went out far and near to use old and new coin together.
units.literal: On renwu orders were issued far and near to use ancient and modern coins mixed together.

units.zh: 戊戌，齊遣大將蕭軌出柵口，向梁山，司空陳霸先、軍主黃菆逆擊，大破之。
units.en: On wuxu Qi sent Grand General Xiao Gui from Zha Pass toward Liang Mountain; Minister of Works Chen Baxian and army commander Huang Kan counterattacked and routed them.
units.literal: On wuxu Qi sent Grand General Xiao Gui out through Zha Pass toward Liang Mountain; Minister of Works Chen Baxian and army commander Huang Kan struck in counterattack and greatly defeated them.

units.zh: 軌退保蕪湖。
units.en: Gui fell back to Wuhu.
units.literal: Gui retreated to hold Wuhu.

units.zh: 遣周文育、侯安都衆軍，據梁山拒之。
units.en: Zhou Wenyu and Hou Andu were sent with the main armies to hold Liang Mountain against them.
units.literal: Zhou Wenyu and Hou Andu with the massed armies were sent to hold Liang Mountain and resist them.

units.zh: 夏四月丁巳，司空陳霸先表詣梁山撫巡將帥。
units.en: On dingsi in the fourth month of summer Minister of Works Chen Baxian memorialized to visit Liang Mountain and reassure the commanders.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, day dingsi, Minister of Works Chen Baxian memorialized to go to Liang Mountain to comfort and tour the generals.

units.zh: 壬申，侯安都輕兵襲齊行臺司馬恭于歷陽，大破之，俘獲萬計。
units.en: On renshen Hou Andu with light troops raided Qi field headquarters Sima Gong at Liyang, routed him, and took tens of thousands captive.
units.literal: On renshen Hou Andu with light troops raided Qi field headquarters Sima Gong at Liyang, greatly defeated him, captives and booty in tens of thousands.

units.zh: 五月癸未，太傅建安公淵明薨。
units.en: In the fifth month, on guiwei day, Yuanming, Duke of Jian'an and grand tutor, died.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on guiwei day, Grand Tutor Duke Yuanming of Jian'an died.

units.zh: 庚寅，齊軍水步入丹陽縣。
units.en: On gengyin day, Qi forces by water and land entered Danyang county.
units.literal: On gengyin day, Qi naval and infantry forces entered Danyang county.

units.zh: 丙申，至秣陵故冶。
units.en: On bingshen day, they reached the old foundry at Moling.
units.literal: On bingshen day, they reached the old foundry at Moling.

units.zh: 敕周文育還頓方丘，徐度頓馬牧，杜棱頓大桁。
units.en: An order sent Zhou Wenyu back to camp at Fangqiu, Xu Du to camp at Mamu, and Du Leng to camp at Dahang.
units.literal: An order directed Zhou Wenyu to return and encamp at Fangqiu, Xu Du to encamp at Mamu, and Du Leng to encamp at Dahang.

units.zh: 癸卯，齊軍進據兒塘，輿駕出頓趙建故籬門，內外纂嚴。
units.en: On guimao day, the Qi army advanced to occupy Ertang. The emperor went out to camp at Zhao Jian's old hedge gate, and defenses were tightened inside and outside.
units.literal: On guimao day, the Qi army advanced and occupied Ertang; the imperial carriage went out and encamped at Zhao Jian's old hedge gate, and inside and outside all tightened their defenses.

units.zh: 六月甲辰，齊潛軍至蔣山龍尾，斜趨莫府山北，至玄武廟西北。
units.en: On jiachen in the sixth month Qi secretly moved troops to Jiang Mountain's Dragon Tail, angling north past Mofu Mountain to the northwest of the Xuanwu Shrine.
units.literal: On jiachen in the sixth month Qi secretly sent troops to Jiang Mountain Dragon Tail, slanting toward Mofu Mountain north, reaching northwest of the Xuanwu Shrine.

units.zh: 乙卯，司空陳霸先授衆軍節度，與齊軍交戰，大破之，斬齊北兗州刺史杜方慶及徐嗣徽、弟嗣宗，生擒徐嗣產、蕭軌、東方老、王敬寶、李希光、裴英起、劉歸義等，皆誅之。
units.en: On yimao Minister of Works Chen Baxian took command of the armies, met the Qi force, and won a great victory; he beheaded Qi's North Yanzhou inspector Du Fangqing, Xu Sihui, and Sihui's brother Sizong; he captured Xu Sichan, Xiao Gui, Dongfang Lao, Wang Jingbao, Li Xiguang, Pei Yingqi, Liu Guiyi, and others alive and executed them all.
units.literal: On yimao Minister of Works Chen Baxian conferred command tokens on the massed armies and joined battle with Qi troops, greatly defeating them; beheaded Qi North Yanzhou Inspector Du Fangqing and Xu Sihui and his younger brother Sizong; captured alive Xu Sichan, Xiao Gui, Dongfang Lao, Wang Jingbao, Li Xiguang, Pei Yingqi, Liu Guiyi, and others—all were executed.

units.zh: 戊午，大赦天下，軍士身殞戰場，悉遣斂祭，其無家屬，卽爲瘞埋。
units.en: On wuwu a general amnesty was declared; soldiers who fell in battle were given burial rites, and those without kin were buried on the spot.
units.literal: On wuwu great amnesty under heaven; soldiers whose bodies fell on the battlefield—all were sent for burial rites; those without kin were at once buried in the field.

units.zh: 辛酉，解嚴。
units.en: On xinyou the emergency curfew was lifted.
units.literal: On xinyou the emergency was lifted.

units.zh: 秋七月丙子，車騎將軍、司空陳霸先進位司徒，加中書監，餘如故。
units.en: On bingzi in the seventh month of autumn Chariots and Cavalry General and Minister of Works Chen Baxian was promoted to Minister of Education and Supervisor of the Masters of Documents; other posts were unchanged.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, day bingzi, Chariots and Cavalry General and Minister of Works Chen Baxian was advanced to Minister of Education with added Supervisor of the Masters of Documents; the rest unchanged.

units.zh: 丁亥，以開府儀同三司侯瑱爲司空。
units.en: On dinghai Hou Tian, whose gate equaled the Three Excellencies, became Minister of Works.
units.literal: On dinghai Gate Equal to Three Excellencies Hou Tian was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 八月己酉，太保鄱陽王循薨。
units.en: On jiyou in the eighth month Grand Mentor Prince Xun of Poyang died.
units.literal: On jiyou in the eighth month Grand Mentor Prince Xun of Poyang died.

units.zh: 九月壬寅，改元大赦，孝悌力田賜爵一級，殊才異行所在奏聞，饑難流移勒歸本土。
units.en: On renyin in the ninth month the era name was changed and a general amnesty granted; the filial, dutiful, and diligent in farming received one noble rank; unusual talent was to be reported from each region; famine refugees were ordered home.
units.literal: On renyin in the ninth month the era name was changed and great amnesty granted; filial piety, brotherliness, and strength in farming were granted one noble rank; extraordinary talent and conduct were to be memorialized from wherever found; those displaced by famine were ordered back to native lands.

units.zh: 進新除司徒陳霸先爲丞相、錄尚書事、鎮衛大將軍、揚州牧，封義興郡公。
units.en: The new Minister of Education Chen Baxian was promoted to chancellor, Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand General Who Guards the Realm, and Yangzhou governor, and enfeoffed as Duke of Yixing.
units.literal: Newly appointed Minister of Education Chen Baxian was advanced to Chancellor, Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand General Who Guards the Realm, and Yangzhou Governor; he was enfeoffed Duke of Yixing commandery.

units.zh: 中權將軍王沖卽本號開府儀同三司。
units.en: Central Authority General Wang Chong received a gate equal to the Three Excellencies at his existing rank.
units.literal: Central Authority General Wang Chong at his original title was given gate equal to the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 吏部尚書王通爲尚書右僕射。
units.en: Minister of Personnel Wang Tong became Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Minister of Personnel Wang Tong was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 丁巳，以郢州刺史徐度爲領軍將軍。
units.en: On dingsi Yingzhou inspector Xu Du became General of the Forward Command.
units.literal: On dingsi Yingzhou Inspector Xu Du was made General of the Forward Command.

units.zh: 冬十一月乙卯，起雲龍、神虎門。
units.en: On yimao in the eleventh month of winter the Cloud Dragon and Spirit Tiger gates were built.
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, day yimao, Cloud Dragon and Spirit Tiger gates were raised.

units.zh: 十二月壬申，進太尉、鎮南將軍蕭勃爲太保、驃騎將軍。
units.en: On renshen in the twelfth month Grand Master of War and Pacifying South General Xiao Bo was promoted to Grand Mentor and Rapid Cavalry General.
units.literal: On renshen in the twelfth month Grand Master of War and Pacifying South General Xiao Bo was advanced to Grand Mentor and Rapid Cavalry General.

units.zh: 以新除左衛將軍歐陽頠爲安南將軍、衡州刺史。
units.en: Newly appointed Left Guard General Ouyang He became Pacifying South General and Hengzhou inspector.
units.literal: Newly appointed Left Guard General Ouyang He was made Pacifying South General and Hengzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 壬午，平南將軍劉法瑜進號安南將軍。
units.en: On renwu Pacifying South General Liu Fayu was promoted to Annan General.
units.literal: On renwu Pacifying South General Liu Fayu had his title advanced to Pacifying South General.

units.zh: 甲午，以前壽昌令劉叡爲汝陰王，前鎮西法曹、行參軍蕭紞爲巴陵王，奉宋、齊二代后。
units.en: On jiawu former Shouchang magistrate Liu Rui was made Prince of Ruyin; former Pacify West legal bureau acting staff officer Xiao Dan was made Prince of Baling to attend the Song and Qi empresses.
units.literal: On jiawu former Shouchang magistrate Liu Rui was made Prince of Ruyin; former Pacify West legal bureau acting staff officer Xiao Dan was made Prince of Baling, attending upon the empresses of Song and Qi.

units.zh: 二年春正月壬寅，詔曰：「夫子降靈體喆，經仁緯義，允光素王，載闡玄功，仰之者彌高，誨之者不倦。
units.en: On renyin in the first month of spring, year 2, an edict said: "The Master came down in spirit with perfected substance, threading benevolence and weaving righteousness, truly illuminating the uncrowned king and unfolding his hidden work; those who look up find him ever higher, those he teaches never weary.
units.literal: In spring, the first month, day renyin, year 2, an edict said: "The Master descended in spirit with perfected substance, threading benevolence and weaving righteousness, truly illuminating the uncrowned king, bearing forth mysterious achievement—those who look up find him ever higher, those he teaches never tire.

units.zh: 立忠立孝，德被蒸民，制禮作樂，道冠羣后。
units.en: He established loyalty and filial piety and his virtue covered the people; he made rites and composed music and his Way surpassed all kings.
units.literal: Establishing loyalty and filial piety, his virtue covered the ordinary people; making rites and composing music, his Way topped all rulers.

units.zh: 雖泰山頹峻，一簣不遺，而泗水餘瀾，千載猶在。
units.en: Though Mount Tai fell and not a basket of earth was left, the lingering ripples of Sishui endure a thousand years on.
units.literal: Though Mount Tai collapsed in loftiness and not one basket of earth remained, yet the surplus ripples of Sishui remain a thousand years later.

units.zh: 自皇圖屯阻，祀薦不脩，奉聖之門，胤嗣殲滅，敬神之寢，簠簋寂寥。
units.en: Since the imperial house was blocked, sacrifices were not kept up; at the Gate of Veneration of the Sage heirs were destroyed; at the shrine of the revered spirit meat and grain vessels stood empty.
units.literal: Since the imperial chart was obstructed, sacrificial offerings were not maintained; the gate of Veneration of the Sage—heirs and offspring were annihilated; the shrine of revering the spirit—meat and grain vessels stood empty.

units.zh: 永言聲烈，實兼欽愴。
units.en: His fame and merit move one always to reverent grief.
units.literal: Forever speaking his fame and splendor, truly mixed with reverent anguish.

units.zh: 外可搜舉魯國之族，以爲奉聖後；
units.en: Abroad, the clan of Lu is to be sought out and one chosen as heir to Veneration of the Sage;
units.literal: Without, one may search and recommend the clan of Lu state to serve as heir to Veneration of the Sage;

units.zh: 並繕廟堂，供備祀典，四時薦秩，一皆遵舊。」
units.en: and temple halls are to be repaired, offerings supplied, and seasonal sacrifices conducted as of old."
units.literal: and together repair temple halls, supply and prepare sacrificial canon; seasonal offerings—all follow the old."

units.zh: 是日，又詔「諸州各置中正，依舊訪舉。
units.en: That same day another edict said: "Each province shall appoint a rectifier and, as before, seek out candidates.
units.literal: That day, another edict: "Each province shall establish a rectifier, according to old custom visiting and recommending.

units.zh: 不得輒承單狀序官，皆須中正押上，然後量授。
units.en: No one may advance on a lone petition alone; the rectifier must endorse it first, and only then is appointment to be made.
units.literal: One may not at once receive a single petition to sequence office; all must have the rectifier's seal affixed above, then measure and appoint.

units.zh: 詳依品制，務使精實。
units.en: Grades are to be applied with care so that appointments are exact.
units.literal: Examine in detail according to rank grades, striving to make them refined and true.

units.zh: 其荊、雍、青、兗雖暫爲隔閡，衣冠多寓淮海，猶宜不廢司存。
units.en: Though Jing, Yong, Qing, and Yan were for a time cut off, many gentry and officials still lived around the Huai; their offices should not be abolished.
units.literal: Though Jing, Yong, Qing, and Yan for a time were blocked apart, gentry and officials mostly dwelt at Huaihai—still one should not abolish their bureau existence.

units.zh: 會計罷州，尚爲大郡，人士殷曠，可別置邑居。
units.en: Kuaiji, though its province had been abolished, remained a great commandery with many scholars and officials; separate settlements may be established.
units.literal: Kuaiji had abolished its province yet was still a great commandery; scholars and officials were numerous and broad—one may separately establish town residences.

units.zh: 至如分割郡縣，新號州牧，並系本邑，不勞兼置。
units.en: Where commanderies and counties are split and new provincial governors are named, they remain tied to their original seats and need no duplicate offices.
units.literal: As for dividing commanderies and counties and newly titling provincial governors—all attach to original towns, without trouble of duplicate establishment.

units.zh: 其選中正，每求耆德，該悉以他官領之。」
units.en: In choosing rectifiers, elders of virtue are to be sought, and knowledgeable men in other offices are to head the process."
units.literal: In selecting rectifiers, each time seek elders of virtue; comprehensively know and have other offices lead them."

units.zh: 以車騎將軍、開府儀同三司王琳爲司空、驃騎大將軍。
units.en: Chariots and Cavalry General Wang Lin, whose gate equaled the Three Excellencies, became Minister of Works and Grand Rapid Cavalry General.
units.literal: Chariots and Cavalry General, Gate Equal to Three Excellencies Wang Lin was made Minister of Works and Grand Rapid Cavalry General.

units.zh: 分尋陽、太原、齊昌、高唐、新蔡五郡，置西江州，卽於尋陽仍充州鎮。
units.en: Five commanderies—Xunyang, Taiyuan, Qichang, Gaotang, and Xincai—were split off to form West Jiang province, with Xunyang as its seat.
units.literal: Xunyang, Taiyuan, Qichang, Gaotang, and Xincai—five commanderies were divided to establish West Jiang province; at Xunyang it still served as provincial seat.

units.zh: 又詔「宗室在朝開國承家者，今猶稱世子，可悉聽襲本爵。」
units.en: Another edict said: "Among the imperial clan in court who hold fiefs and inherit houses, those still called heir apparent may all succeed to their original titles."
units.literal: Another edict: "Among the imperial clan in court who opened states and inherited families, they still now say heir apparent—all may be permitted to succeed to their original ranks."

units.zh: 以尚書右僕射王通爲尚書左僕射。
units.en: Right Vice Director Wang Tong became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Right Vice Director Wang Tong was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 丁巳，鎮西將軍、益州刺史長沙王韶進號征南將軍。
units.en: On dingsi Pacify West General and Yizhou inspector Prince Shao of Changsha was promoted to Conquering South General.
units.literal: On dingsi Pacify West General and Yizhou Inspector Prince Shao of Changsha had his title advanced to Conquering South General.

units.zh: 二月庚午，領軍將軍徐度入東關。
units.en: On gengwu in the second month Forward Command General Xu Du entered Dong Pass.
units.literal: On gengwu in the second month Forward Command General Xu Du entered Dong Pass.

units.zh: 太保、廣州刺史蕭勃舉兵反，遣偽帥歐陽頠、傅泰、勃從子孜爲前軍，南江州刺史余孝頃以兵會之。
units.en: Grand Mentor and Guangzhou inspector Xiao Bo rebelled; he sent Ouyang He, Fu Tai, and his nephew Zi as the vanguard; South Jiangzhou inspector Yu Xiaoqing joined him with troops.
units.literal: Grand Mentor and Guangzhou Inspector Xiao Bo raised troops in revolt; he sent false commander Ouyang He, Fu Tai, and Bo's nephew Zi as forward army; South Jiangzhou Inspector Yu Xiaoqing joined with troops.

units.zh: 詔平西將軍周文育、平南將軍侯安都等率衆軍南討。
units.en: An edict ordered Pacify West General Zhou Wenyu, Pacify South General Hou Andu, and others to lead the armies south against him.
units.literal: An edict ordered Pacify West General Zhou Wenyu, Pacify South General Hou Andu, and others to lead the massed armies south to suppress.

units.zh: 戊子，徐度至合肥，燒齊船三千艘。
units.en: On wuzi Xu Du reached Hefei and burned three thousand Qi ships.
units.literal: On wuzi Xu Du reached Hefei and burned three thousand Qi ships.

units.zh: 癸巳，周文育軍于巴山生獲歐陽頠。
units.en: On guisi Zhou Wenyu's army at Bashan took Ouyang He alive.
units.literal: On guisi Zhou Wenyu's army at Bashan captured Ouyang He alive.

units.zh: 三月庚子，文育前軍丁法洪于蹠口生俘傅泰。
units.en: On gengzi in the third month Wenyu's vanguard Ding Fahong at Zhi Pass captured Fu Tai alive.
units.literal: On gengzi in the third month Wenyu's forward army Ding Fahong at Zhi Pass captured Fu Tai alive.

units.zh: 蕭孜、余孝頃軍退走。
units.en: Xiao Zi and Yu Xiaoqing's armies withdrew and fled.
units.literal: Xiao Zi and Yu Xiaoqing's armies retreated and fled.

units.zh: 甲辰，以新除司空王琳爲湘、郢二州刺史。
units.en: On jiachen the new Minister of Works Wang Lin became inspector of Xiang and Ying.
units.literal: On jiachen newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Lin was made inspector of Xiang and Ying two provinces.

units.zh: 甲寅，德州刺史陳法武、前衡州刺史譚世遠於始興攻殺蕭勃。
units.en: On jiayin Dezhou inspector Chen Fawu and former Hengzhou inspector Tan Shiyuan attacked and killed Xiao Bo at Shixing.
units.literal: On jiayin Dezhou Inspector Chen Fawu and former Hengzhou Inspector Tan Shiyuan at Shixing attacked and killed Xiao Bo.

units.zh: 夏四月癸酉，曲赦江、廣、衡三州；
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on guiyou, Jiang, Guang, and Heng received a partial amnesty;
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guiyou, a partial amnesty was granted to Jiang, Guang, and Heng provinces;

units.zh: 並督內爲賊所拘逼者，並皆不問。
units.en: and all in those provinces coerced by rebels were pardoned without inquiry.
units.literal: and all within those provinces who had been coerced by rebels were likewise not questioned.

units.zh: 己卯，鑄四柱錢，一準二十。
units.en: On jimao four-pillar coin was cast, one worth twenty.
units.literal: On jimao, four-pillar cash was cast, one standard to twenty.

units.zh: 齊遣使請和。
units.en: Qi sent envoys seeking peace.
units.literal: Qi sent envoys seeking peace.

units.zh: 壬辰，改四柱錢一準十。
units.en: On renchen four-pillar coin was revalued one to ten.
units.literal: On renchen, four-pillar cash was changed to one standard to ten.

units.zh: 丙申，復閉細錢。
units.en: On bingshen small coin was again abolished.
units.literal: On bingshen, small cash was again closed from circulation.

units.zh: 蕭勃故主帥前直閤蘭敱襲殺譚世遠，敱仍爲亡命夏侯明徹所殺。
units.en: Xiao Bo's former chief commander Lan Ai, a former Direct Attendant, killed Tan Shiyuan; Ai was then killed by the outlaw Xiahou Mingche.
units.literal: Xiao Bo's former chief commander, former Direct Attendant Lan Ai, raided and killed Tan Shiyuan; Ai was then killed by the outlaw Xia Hou Mingche.

units.zh: 勃故記室李寶藏奉懷安侯蕭任據廣州作亂。
units.en: Bo's former secretary Li Baocang backed Marquis of Huai'an Xiao Ren in seizing Guangzhou and rebelling.
units.literal: Bo's former secretary Li Baocang supported Marquis of Huai'an Xiao Ren in holding Guangzhou and rising in rebellion.

units.zh: 戊戌，侯安都進軍，余孝頃棄軍走，蕭孜請降，豫章平。
units.en: On wuxu Hou Andu advanced; Yu Xiaoqing fled; Xiao Zi surrendered, and Yuzhang was pacified.
units.literal: On wuxu, Hou Andu advanced his army; Yu Xiaoqing abandoned his force and fled; Xiao Zi asked to surrender, and Yuzhang was pacified.

units.zh: 五月乙巳，平西將軍周文育進號鎮南將軍，侯安都進號鎮北將軍，並以本號開府儀同三司。
units.en: In the fifth month, on yisi, Zhou Wenyü was promoted from General Who Pacifies the West to General Who Pacifies the South; Hou Andu from General Who Pacifies the South to General Who Pacifies the North—both kept their titles and received Opening Office Equal to Three Departments.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on yisi, General Who Pacifies the West Zhou Wenyü was promoted to General Who Pacifies the South; General Who Pacifies the South Hou Andu was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North—both with their former titles received Opening Office Equal to Three Departments.

units.zh: 丙午，以鎮軍將軍徐度爲南豫州刺史。
units.en: On bingwu Pacifying Army General Xu Du became South Yuzhou inspector.
units.literal: On bingwu, General of the Pacifying Army Xu Du was made Inspector of South Yuzhou.

units.zh: 戊辰，余孝頃遣使詣丞相府乞降。
units.en: On wuchen Yu Xiaoqing sent envoys to the chancellor's office to surrender.
units.literal: On wuchen, Yu Xiaoqing sent envoys to the Chancellor's office begging to surrender.

units.zh: 秋八月甲午，加丞相陳霸先黃鉞，領太傅，劍履上殿，入朝不趨，贊拜不名，給羽葆、鼓吹。
units.en: On jiawu in the eighth month of autumn Chancellor Chen Baxian received the yellow axe, became Grand Tutor, and was granted sword in the hall, no hurrying at court, praise without naming, and feather canopy and martial music.
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiawu, Chancellor Chen Baxian was granted the yellow axe, made Grand Tutor, sword and shoes in the hall, no hurrying in court attendance, not named when praised in obeisance, granted feather canopy and martial music.

units.zh: 九月辛丑，崇丞相爲相國，總百揆，封十郡爲陳公，備九錫之禮，加璽紱遠遊冠，位在王公上。
units.en: On xinchou in the ninth month the chancellor was raised to chancellor of state, head of the hundred officials, enfeoffed Duke of Chen over ten commanderies, granted the Nine Bestowals with seal ribbon and far-wandering cap, and ranked above princes.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on xinchou, the Chancellor was exalted to Chancellor of State, head of the hundred officials, enfeoffed as Duke of Chen over ten commanderies, granted the full Nine Bestowals, with seal ribbon and far-wandering cap added, rank above kings and dukes.

units.zh: 加相國綠綟綬。
units.en: A green sash was added for the chancellor of state.
units.literal: Green sash for the Chancellor of State was added.

units.zh: 置陳國百司。
units.en: The hundred offices of the state of Chen were established.
units.literal: The hundred offices of the State of Chen were established.

units.zh: 冬十月戊辰，進陳公爵爲王，增封十郡，並前爲二十郡。
units.en: On wuchen in the tenth winter month the Duke of Chen was advanced to king, with ten more commanderies added for twenty in all.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuchen, Duke of Chen was advanced to King; ten more commanderies were added to the enfeoffment, making twenty altogether.

units.zh: 命陳王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旂，出警入蹕，乘金根車，駕六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲罕，樂舞八佾，設鍾鋋宮縣。
units.en: The king of Chen was ordered twelve cap tassels, Son of Heaven banners, road cleared on exit and return, the golden-root carriage with six horses, five-season secondary carriages, yak-tail and cloud pennants, eight rows of music and dance, and palace bell frames.
units.literal: The King of Chen was ordered to wear twelve cap tassels, raise the Son of Heaven's banners, clear the road on going out and returning, ride the golden-root carriage, drive six horses, have five-season secondary carriages prepared, set yak-tail and cloud pennants, music and dance of eight rows, and establish bell frames and palace suspended instruments.

units.zh: 王后王子女爵命之典，一依舊儀。
units.en: Rites for queen, royal children, and enfeoffment all followed former usage.
units.literal: The regulations for investiture of queen, king's children, and enfeoffment ranks all followed the old ceremonies.

units.zh: 辛未，詔曰：
units.en: On xinwei an edict said:
units.literal: On xinwei, an edict said:

units.zh: 五運更始，三正迭代，司牧黎庶，是屬聖賢，用能經緯乾坤，彌綸區宇，大庇黔首，闡揚洪烈。
units.en: The five phases turn anew, the three calendars succeed one another; to shepherd the people belongs to the sage, who can weave heaven and earth, cover the realm, shelter the masses, and spread the grand achievement.
units.literal: The five movements begin anew, the three orthodoxies succeed one another; to shepherd the black-haired people belongs to the sage and worthy, whereby one can weave heaven and earth, cover the four quarters, greatly shelter the people, and spread the grand achievement.

units.zh: 革晦以明，積代同軌，百王踵武，咸由此則。
units.en: Darkness gave way to light, age after age on one track—hundred kings followed in martial steps, all by this rule.
units.literal: Changing darkness to brightness, age piled upon age on the same track—hundred kings followed in martial steps, all by this rule.

units.zh: 梁德湮微，禍難薦發：太清云始，用困長蛇；
units.en: Liang virtue sank; calamity followed in succession: at Great Clarity's start one was trapped by the long serpent;
units.literal: Liang virtue sank and faded; calamity and disorder arose in succession: at the beginning of Great Clarity one was trapped by the long serpent;

units.zh: 承聖之年，又罹封豕；
units.en: in Receiving Sagacity's year one again suffered the ravenous boar;
units.literal: in the year of Receiving Sagacity one again suffered the ravenous boar;

units.zh: 爰至天成，重竊神器。
units.en: when Heavenly Completion came, the sacred vessel was stolen again.
units.literal: when it reached Heavenly Completion, the sacred vessel was again stolen.

units.zh: 三光亟改，七廟乏祀，含生已泯，鼎命斯墜，我皇之祚，眇若綴旒，靜惟《屯》、《剝》，夕惕載懷。
units.en: The three lights changed, the seven temples went without sacrifice; life was spent, the mandate fell—our imperial fortune hung like a dangling tassel; quietly I pondered ruin and stripping, and evening vigilance filled my breast.
units.literal: The three luminaries swiftly changed, the seven temples lacked sacrifice; living beings were already extinguished, the bronze mandate fell—our emperor's fortune was like a dangling tassel; quietly I pondered difficulty and stripping, evening vigilance filled my breast.

units.zh: 相國陳王，有縱自天，降神惟嶽，天地合德，晷曜齊明。
units.en: Chancellor of state and king of Chen were Heaven's chosen, spirit from the sacred peak; heaven and earth shared his virtue, sun and stars burned bright with him.
units.literal: The Chancellor of State, King of Chen, was Heaven's chosen, his descending spirit from the sacred peak; heaven and earth united in virtue, the sun-staff and stars alike bright.

units.zh: 拯社稷之橫流，提億兆之塗炭。
units.en: He saved the altars from the flood and lifted the millions from the coals.
units.literal: He saved the altars from the crosscurrent and lifted the hundred million from charcoal.

units.zh: 東誅叛逆，北殲獯丑，威加四海，仁漸萬國。
units.en: East he punished rebels, north he destroyed the Xianyun; his awesomeness filled the four seas, his kindness spread to every state.
units.literal: East he punished rebellion, north he destroyed the Xianyun fiends; awesomeness reached the four seas, benevolence spread to the myriad states.

units.zh: 復張崩樂，重紀絕禮，儒館聿修，戎亭虛候。
units.en: He restored fallen music and raised extinct rites; Confucian halls were repaired and barbarian posts stood empty.
units.literal: He restored collapsed music, again raised extinct rites; Confucian halls were repaired, barbarian posts stood empty of scouts.

units.zh: 雖大功在舜，盛績維禹，巍巍蕩蕩，無得而稱。
units.en: Though his merit matched Shun and his achievement only Yu, he was vast beyond naming.
units.literal: Though great merit lay in Shun and splendid achievement only in Yu, vast, vast—none could name it.

units.zh: 來獻白環，豈直皇虞之世；
units.en: White rings came as tribute—was that only in the age of august Yu?
units.literal: White rings came as tribute—was it only in the age of august Yu?

units.zh: 入貢素雉，非止隆周之日。
units.en: White pheasants were offered—not only in exalted Zhou.
units.literal: White pheasants entered tribute—not only on the exalted Zhou day.

units.zh: 故效珍川陸，表瑞煙雲，玉露醴泉，旦夕凝涌，嘉禾瑞草，孳植郊甸，道昭于悠代，勛格於皇穹。
units.en: Treasures rose from rivers and land, omens from mist and cloud; sweet dew and sweet springs welled morning and evening; fine grain and auspicious grass sprouted thick in the suburbs; the Way shone in distant ages and merit reached heaven.
units.literal: Thus treasures were offered on rivers and land, omens shown in mist and cloud; sweet dew and sweet springs morning and evening welled and surged; fine grain and auspicious grass sprouted thick in the suburbs; the Way was clear in distant ages, merit reached the august vault.

units.zh: 明明上天，光華日月，革故著于玄象，代德彰于讖圖，獄訟有違，謳歌爰適，天之曆數，實有攸在。
units.en: Bright was high heaven, glory to sun and moon; change of the old was written in the dark signs, succession of virtue in the charts; lawsuits found their judge, songs of praise turned here—the heavenly succession truly had its lord.
units.literal: Bright, bright was high heaven, glory to sun and moon; change of the old was written in the dark signs, succession of virtue shown in the charts; lawsuits had their turn, songs of praise turned this way—the heavenly succession truly had its place.

units.zh: 朕雖庸藐，暗于古昔，永稽崇替，爲日已久，敢忘列代之遺典，人祇之至願乎！
units.en: Though I am mediocre and small, dark on antiquity, long have I traced rise and fall; how dare I forget the former dynasties' statutes and the utmost wish of men and spirits!
units.literal: Though I am mediocre and small, dark on antiquity, long have I traced exaltation and replacement; how dare I forget the former dynasties' handed statutes and the utmost wish of men and spirits!

units.zh: 今便遜位別宮，敬禪于陳，一依唐虞、宋齊故事。
units.en: Now I yield the throne to a separate palace and respectfully abdicate to Chen, following the stories of Tang and Yu, Song and Qi.
units.literal: Now I yield the throne to a separate palace and respectfully abdicate to Chen, all following the stories of Tang and Yu, Song and Qi.

units.zh: 陳王踐阼，奉帝爲江陰王，薨于外邸，時年十六，追諡敬皇帝。
units.en: When the King of Chen ascended the throne, he made the emperor King of Jiangyin. The emperor died at his outer residence at the age of sixteen, and was posthumously titled Emperor Jing.
units.literal: When the King of Chen ascended the throne, he made the emperor King of Jiangyin. The emperor died at his outer residence at the age of sixteen, and was posthumously titled Emperor Jing.

units.zh: 史臣曰：梁季橫潰，喪亂屢臻，當此之時，天歷去矣，敬皇高讓，將同釋負焉。
units.en: The historiographer says: When the Liang age collapsed, calamity followed calamity; Heaven's mandate had departed; Emperor Jing's high abdication was like laying down a burden.
units.literal: The historiographer says: When the Liang age collapsed in ruin, calamities and disorder came one after another; at this time Heaven's mandate had departed; Emperor Jing's high abdication was about to be like laying down a burden.

units.zh: 史臣侍中、鄭國公魏徵曰：「高祖固天攸縱，聰明稽古，道亞生知，學爲博物，允文允武，多藝多才。
units.en: The historiographer, Attendant-in-Ordinary and Duke of Zheng Wei Zheng, said, "The High Ancestor was indeed one whom Heaven let range freely: intelligent and versed in antiquity, his Way nearly matched innate knowledge; his learning made him broadly informed, truly civil and martial, accomplished in many arts and talents.
units.literal: The historiographer, Attendant-in-Ordinary and Duke of Zheng Wei Zheng, said: "The High Ancestor was indeed Heaven's chosen, intelligent and versed in antiquity; his Way nearly matched innate knowledge, his learning was that of broad learning; he was both wen and wu, with many arts and many talents.

units.zh: 爰自諸生，有不羈之度，屬昏凶肆虐，天倫及禍，收合義旅，將雪家冤。
units.en: From his student days he had an untamed spirit; when the wicked ran rampant and kin met calamity, he gathered righteous troops to avenge the family.
units.literal: From his days as a student he had an untamed spirit; when the wicked and fierce ran rampant and family bonds met calamity, he gathered righteous troops to wipe away the family's wrong.

units.zh: 曰紂可伐，不其而會，龍躍樊、漢，電擊湘、郢，剪離德如振槁，取獨夫如拾遺。
units.en: He said Zhou could be punished; allies assembled unlooked-for; he leapt like a dragon at Fan and Han and struck like lightning at Xiang and Ying; cutting down those of alienated virtue was like shaking dry stalks; taking the lone tyrant was like picking up what was lost.
units.literal: He said Zhou could be punished; without expecting it they assembled; he leapt like a dragon at Fan and Han and struck like lightning at Xiang and Ying; cutting off the virtue of Li was like shaking dry stalks; taking the lone tyrant was like picking up what was lost.

units.zh: 其雄才大略，固無得而稱矣。
units.en: His heroic talent and great design truly cannot be fully praised.
units.literal: His heroic talent and great design truly cannot be fully praised.

units.zh: 旣懸白旗之首，方應皇天之眷，布德施惠，悅近來遠，開蕩蕩之王道，革靡靡之商俗，大修文教，盛飾禮容，鼓扇玄風，闡揚儒業，介胄仁義，折衝樽俎，聲振寰宇，澤流遐裔，干戈載戢，凡數十年。
units.en: He hung the head on the white flag, then answered Heaven's favor; he spread virtue and grace, pleased the near and reached the far; opened the broad royal Way and reformed Shang decadence; cultivated wen and education, adorned ritual, stirred the mysterious wind, and exalted Confucian learning; armor wore benevolence and righteousness; he overturned foes at the banquet table; his fame shook the realm and grace flowed abroad; weapons were laid aside for decades.
units.literal: Already he had hung the head on the white flag; then he answered Heaven's favor; he spread virtue and showed grace, pleasing the near and reaching the far; he opened the broad Way of kings and reformed the decadent customs of Shang; he greatly cultivated wen and education, richly adorned ritual and bearing, stirred the mysterious wind, and exalted Confucian enterprise; armor wore benevolence and righteousness; he overturned the enemy at the banquet table; his fame shook the realm and his grace flowed to distant lands; weapons were laid aside for several decades.

units.zh: 濟濟焉，洋洋焉，魏、晉已來，未有若斯之盛。
units.en: Vast and abundant—since Wei and Jin there had been nothing like this splendor.
units.literal: Vast and abundant—since Wei and Jin there had been nothing like this splendor.

units.zh: 然不能息末敦本，斫雕爲朴，慕名好事，崇尚浮華，抑揚孔、墨，流連釋、老。
units.en: Yet he could not rest the branch and strengthen the root or carve away ornament for simplicity; he admired reputation, loved novelty, and honored the floating and splendid; he elevated and suppressed Confucius and Mozi and lingered over Buddhism and Daoism.
units.literal: Yet he could not rest the branch and strengthen the root, carve away ornament and return to simplicity; he admired reputation and loved novelty and honored the floating and splendid; he elevated and suppressed Confucius and Mozi and lingered over Buddhism and Daoism.

units.zh: 或經夜不寢，或終日不食，非弘道以利物，惟飾智以驚愚。
units.en: Sometimes he did not sleep all night; sometimes he did not eat until sunset—not to broaden the Way for the world's good, but only to adorn wisdom and startle fools.
units.literal: Sometimes he did not sleep the whole night; sometimes he did not eat until the sun set—not to broaden the Way to benefit things, but only to adorn wisdom and startle fools.

units.zh: 且心未遺榮，虛廁蒼頭之伍；
units.en: Moreover his heart had not left glory; he vainly sat among menials;
units.literal: Moreover his heart had not left glory; he vainly sat among the ranks of menials;

units.zh: 高談脫屣，終戀黃屋之尊。
units.en: he talked loftily of casting off the world yet to the end cherished the yellow canopy.
units.literal: he talked loftily of casting off the world yet to the end cherished the honor of the yellow canopy.

units.zh: 夫人之大欲，在乎飲食男女，至於軒冕殿堂，非有切身之急。
units.en: Man's great desires lie in food, drink, and men and women; carriages, caps, halls, and palaces are no urgent personal need.
units.literal: The great desires of man lie in food, drink, and the relations of men and women; as for carriages, caps, halls, and palaces—there is no urgent need touching the person.

units.zh: 高祖屏除嗜欲，眷戀軒冕，得其所難而滯于所易，可謂神有所不達，智有所不通矣。
units.en: The High Ancestor screened out appetites yet clung to rank and display; he mastered what is hard yet stalled at what is easy—spirit did not reach everywhere and wisdom did not penetrate all.
units.literal: The High Ancestor screened out appetites yet clung to carriages and caps; he obtained what is hard yet stalled at what is easy—this may be called spirit not reaching everywhere and wisdom not penetrating all.

units.zh: 逮夫精華稍竭，鳳德已衰，惑于聽受，權在奸佞，儲后百辟，莫得盡言。
units.en: When his essence failed and phoenix virtue declined, he was deluded in what he heard and power lay with flatterers; heir and hundred officials could not speak fully.
units.literal: When his essence and splendor gradually failed and phoenix virtue had declined, he was deluded in what he heard and power lay with wicked flatterers; the heir and the hundred officials—none could speak fully.

units.zh: 險躁之心，暮年愈甚。
units.en: His rash and restless heart grew worse in old age.
units.literal: His rash and restless heart grew worse in old age.

units.zh: 見利而動，愎諫違卜，開門揖盜，棄好卽仇，釁起蕭牆，禍成戎羯，身殞非命，災被億兆，衣冠敝鋒鏑之下，老幼粉戎馬之足。
units.en: Seeing profit he moved; he rejected remonstrance and defied divination; opened the gate to robbers, abandoned friendship for enmity; trouble rose within the palace wall; Rong and Jie brought calamity; he died unnaturally and disaster struck the millions; officials perished under arms; old and young were trampled by war horses.
units.literal: Seeing profit he moved; stubbornly he rejected remonstrance and defied divination; he opened the gate to welcome robbers, abandoned friendship and turned to enmity; the provocation arose within the palace wall; calamity was completed by the Rong and Jie; he died an unnatural death and disaster struck hundreds of millions; gentlemen and officials perished under blade and arrow; old and young were ground beneath the hooves of war horses.

units.zh: 瞻彼《黍離》，痛深周廟；
units.en: Gazing at that millet in ruin, grief exceeded the Zhou temple;
units.literal: Gazing at that millet in ruin, the pain exceeded the Zhou temple;

units.zh: 永言《麥秀》，悲甚殷墟。
units.en: forever speaking of the wheat in ear, grief exceeded the ruins of Yin.
units.literal: forever speaking of the wheat in ear, the grief exceeded the ruins of Yin.

units.zh: 自古以安爲危，旣成而敗，顛覆之速，書契所未聞也。
units.en: From antiquity, taking peace as peril and success as failure—the speed of ruin is unheard of in written records.
units.literal: From antiquity, taking peace as peril and success as failure—the speed of overturning is unheard of in written records.

units.zh: 《易》曰：『天之所助者信，人之所助者順。』
units.en: The Changes says, "Heaven helps the faithful; men help the obedient."
units.literal: The Changes says: "Heaven helps the faithful; men help the obedient."

units.zh: 高祖之遇斯屯剝，不得其死，蓋動而之險，不由信順，失天人之所助，其能免於此乎！
units.en: The High Ancestor met hardship and stripping and did not die a natural death—because he moved toward peril, not faith and obedience; losing Heaven's and men's help, how could he escape?
units.literal: That the High Ancestor met this time of hardship and stripping and did not obtain natural death—surely because in movement he went toward peril and did not follow faith and obedience; losing Heaven's and men's help, how could he escape this?

units.zh: 太宗聰睿過人，神彩秀髮，多聞博達，富贍詞藻。
units.en: Taizong was keen beyond others, with splendid spirit and appearance; he heard much, reached far, and was rich in literary ornament.
units.literal: Emperor Taizong was keen and surpassing in men, with spirit and appearance splendidly flourishing; he heard much, reached far, and was rich and ample in literary ornament.

units.zh: 然文艷用寡，華而不實，體窮淫麗，義罕疏通，哀思之音，遂移風俗，以此而貞萬國，異乎周誦、漢庄矣。
units.en: Yet his writing was brilliant but thin, flowery but not solid; his style exhausted licentious beauty and his meaning rarely penetrated; mournful tones shifted custom—holding the myriad states thus differs from King Song of Zhou and Emperor Zhuang of Han.
units.literal: Yet his writing was brilliant but his use sparse, flowery but not solid; his style exhausted licentious beauty and his meaning rarely penetrated; the tone of mournful longing shifted custom—by this to hold the myriad states differs from King Song of Zhou and Emperor Zhuang of Han.

units.zh: 我生不辰，載離多難，桀逆構扇，巨猾滔天，始自牖里之拘，終類望夷之禍。
units.en: I was born at the wrong time, repeatedly parted from peace; cruel rebels stirred turmoil and great villains flooded Heaven—I began like confinement in Youli and ended like Wangyi's calamity.
units.literal: I was born at the wrong time and repeatedly parted from peace; the cruel rebel constructed turmoil and the great villain flooded Heaven—I began like one confined in the windowed room and ended like the calamity at Wangyi.

units.zh: 悠悠蒼天，其可問哉！
units.en: Vast blue Heaven—can it be questioned?
units.literal: Vast blue Heaven—can it be questioned?

units.zh: 昔國步初屯，兵纏魏闕，羣后釋位，投袂勤王。
units.en: When the nation first faltered, war entangled the Wei gate; lords released their posts and rolled up their sleeves to serve the king.
units.literal: Formerly when the nation's step first faltered, war entangled the Wei gate; the feudal lords released their posts and rolled up their sleeves to serve the king.

units.zh: 元帝以盤石之宗，受分陝之任，屬君親之難，居連率之長，不能撫劍嘗膽，枕戈泣血，躬先士卒，致命前驅；
units.en: Emperor Yuan as a foundation stone of the clan received the charge of dividing Shaan; facing ruler and parent in calamity, he held the regional command—yet he could not grasp the sword and taste gall, pillow the spear and weep blood, lead soldiers and stake his life in the vanguard;
units.literal: Emperor Yuan as a foundation stone of the clan received the charge of dividing Shaan; facing the ruler's and parent's calamity, he held the post of regional commander—yet he could not grasp the sword and taste gall, pillow the spear and weep blood, take the lead among soldiers and stake his life in the vanguard;

units.zh: 遂乃擁衆逡巡，內懷觖望，坐觀時變，以爲身幸。
units.en: he held the host yet hesitated, inwardly harbored divided hopes, watched the nation change, and took it as personal fortune.
units.literal: he then held the host yet hesitated, inwardly harbored divided hopes, sat watching the nation's change and took it as personal fortune.

units.zh: 不急莽、卓之誅，先行昆弟之戮。
units.en: He did not urgently punish Wang Mang and Zhuo—first he slaughtered his brothers.
units.literal: He did not urgently seek the punishment of Wang Mang and Zhuo—first he carried out the slaughter of brothers.

units.zh: 又沉猜忌酷，多行無禮。
units.en: Again he was deep in suspicion, cruel, and ruthless, often acting without propriety.
units.literal: Again he was deep in suspicion, cruel, and ruthless, often acting without propriety.

units.zh: 騁智辯以飾非，肆忿戾以害物。
units.en: He deployed clever debate to cover wrong and unleashed wrath to harm people.
units.literal: He deployed clever debate to cover wrong and unleashed wrath and harshness to harm people.

units.zh: 爪牙重將，心膂謀臣，或顧眄以就拘囚，或一言而及菹醢。
units.en: Trusted generals and chief ministers—some were seized with a glance, some reached minced pickle with a single word.
units.literal: Trusted generals and ministers of heart and spine—some were seized with a glance, some reached minced pickle with a single word.

units.zh: 朝之君子，相顧懍然。
units.en: Court gentlemen looked at one another in fear.
units.literal: The gentlemen of the court looked at one another in fear.

units.zh: 自謂安若泰山，舉無遺策，怵于邪說，卽安荊楚。
units.en: He thought himself secure as Mount Tai, his plans without omission; deluded by perverse counsel, he settled in Jing and Chu.
units.literal: He thought himself secure as Mount Tai, his calculations without omission; deluded by perverse counsel, he then settled in Jing and Chu.

units.zh: 雖元惡克剪，社稷未寧，而西鄰責言，禍敗旋及。
units.en: Though the great villain was cut down and the altars were not yet at peace, the western neighbor reproached him and disaster soon followed.
units.literal: Though the great villain was cut down and the altars were not yet at peace, the western neighbor reproached him and disaster and defeat soon followed.

units.zh: 上天降鑒，此焉假手，天道人事，其可誣乎！
units.en: Heaven lowered inspection and lent its hand here; Heaven's Way and human affairs—how can they be deceived?
units.literal: Heaven lowered inspection and lent its hand here; Heaven's Way and human affairs—how can they be deceived?

units.zh: 其篤志藝文，采浮淫而棄忠信；
units.en: His steadfast will in arts and letters gathered the floating and splendid and cast aside loyalty and faith;
units.literal: His steadfast will in arts and letters gathered the floating and splendid and cast aside loyalty and faith;

units.zh: 戎昭果毅，先骨肉而後寇仇。
units.en: in martial proclamation he was resolute and bold—first against kin, then against enemies.
units.literal: in martial proclamation he was resolute and bold—first against kin, then against enemies.

units.zh: 雖口誦《六經》，心通百氏，有仲尼之學，有公旦之才，適足以益其驕矜，增其禍患，何補金陵之覆沒，何救江陵之滅亡哉！
units.en: Though his mouth recited the Six Classics and his heart penetrated the hundred schools; he had Confucius' learning and the Duke of Zhou's talent—yet it only increased his pride and calamities; what did it remedy Jinling's fall or save Jiangling's extinction!
units.literal: Though his mouth recited the Six Classics and his heart penetrated the hundred schools; he had the learning of Confucius and the talent of the Duke of Zhou—yet it only increased his pride and added to his calamities; what did it remedy the fall of Jinling, what did it save the extinction of Jiangling!

units.zh: 敬帝遭家不造，紹茲屯運，征伐有所自出，政刑不由於己，時無伊、霍之輔，焉得不爲高讓歟？」
units.en: Emperor Jing inherited a dynasty in ruin and an age of upheaval. Armies marched at another’s command, and neither government nor justice was his to direct. With no Yi Yin or Huo Guang to support him, how could he have avoided yielding the throne?"
units.literal: Emperor Jing encountered disaster in his ruling house and inherited these troubled times. Military campaigns were directed by others, and neither government nor punishment lay in his own hands. With no Yi Yin or Huo Guang to support him, how could he have avoided the lofty act of yielding the throne?"
